_comment: RSNA 2022 Cervical Spine Fracture Detection Challenge. ~2,019 cervical-spine CT scans from multiple institutions, stored as per-slice DICOMs under train_images/<StudyInstanceUID>/<slice_number>.dcm (slice_number is the integer instance index, not the SOPInstanceUID — single-series studies, no nested SeriesInstanceUID directory). Integrated as 3D per-volume classification: image_path points at the study directory and MONAI's ITKReader assembles the 3D volume on the fly. Each study has 8 binary labels: patient_overall (any-fracture flag) + C1..C7 (per-vertebra fracture flags). 235 studies have slice-level bounding boxes (train_bounding_boxes.csv) and 87 have NIfTI segmentation masks (segmentations/<StudyInstanceUID>.nii). Test set is Kaggle holdout (no labels) — train-only.

primary_csv._comment: train.csv — one row per study with patient_overall + C1..C7 binary labels. Sits one level above base_image_dir (auto-discovered).

patient_id._comment: No distinct patient column — one study per patient in this release. StudyInstanceUID is used as the patient key (mirrors the RSNA PE Detection convention).

image_path._comment: DICOM study DIRECTORY (not a single file). Layout is unusual for a Kaggle CT release — only one level deep (<StudyUID>/<slice>.dcm) rather than the nested <StudyUID>/<SeriesUID>/<SOP>.dcm seen in RSNA PE. MONAI's ITKReader loads all .dcm files in the directory and assembles a 3D volume. Relative to base_image_dir.

labels._comment: 8 binary per-study labels (one-hot 0/1 in train.csv). patient_overall = 1 iff any vertebra fractured; C1..C7 = per-vertebra. Row order in CSV: StudyInstanceUID, patient_overall, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7.

separate_csv._comment: All labels live in the primary train.csv; no separate label CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: All labels are clean 0/1 — no NaN, no -1 in the source CSV.

view_position._comment: N/A — 3D CT volumes have no AP/PA/Lateral concept.

masks._comment: 87 of the 2,019 studies have whole-volume segmentation masks as NIfTI (uint16, ~512×512×~430, voxel ~0.29×0.29×0.5 mm). The harmonizer populates mask_path for those studies and leaves it null for the rest. When output_mask=True, the framework's existing dropna on *_path columns naturally restricts the dataset to the 87 mask-having studies; when output_mask=False all 2,019 studies are visible. Gradio will show the mask overlay when present.

bboxes._comment: 235 of the 2,019 studies have slice-level bounding boxes (train_bounding_boxes.csv: StudyInstanceUID, x, y, width, height, slice_number). Decision: ship a SECOND dataset class RSNA2022CervicalSpineBboxDataset that is 2-D per-slice (one row per (study, slice) with a bbox), mirroring the ChestXray14 / ChestXray14Bbox precedent. The primary 3-D class does not expose bboxes.

reports._comment: No radiology reports in this release.

extra_init_params._comment: No extra constructor params expected beyond the standard 3D pipeline ones (cache_dir, hu_window).
extra_init_params.bbox_csv_path: Optional path to train_bounding_boxes.csv when output_bbox=True (auto-discovered near base_image_dir).
extra_init_params.segmentation_dir: Optional override for the segmentations/ directory (auto-discovered near base_image_dir).

custom_preprocessing: Standard 3D CT pipeline. HU window default [-200, 1800] is bone-centric (cervical spine is the target tissue); override with hu_window=(-1000, 1000) for soft-tissue work.
